content: {"paper_id":"W7212154634","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"despite the presence of erroneous labels, models trained on noisy data often retain the ability to make accurate predictions.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以错误标签/噪声数据训练为研究条件，分析其影响并提出缓解标签不精确所致噪声的方法。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Learning from inaccurate annotations has gained significant attention due to the high cost of precise labeling.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"以不精确标注替代精确实例级真值，并将 inaccurate supervision 作为实质研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"label inaccuracy primarily accumulates noise in lower singular components and subtly perturbs the principal subspace.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要显式分析权重矩阵的奇异分量与主子空间，并提出 LIP 保留主子空间信息，属于对矩阵低秩/子空间结构的利用。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
